description: Authoritative benchmark and test inventory registry for Law 11 VAR System.

experiments.summary: Core Law 11 rule invariants: defender selection, direction sign, ball-line priority, halfway immunity, level tolerance.
State machine transitions across play states: normal play, pass candidate, freeze evidence, resume.
Non-circular hold-out validation on 0.jpg (4 fit points, 4 independent test points).
Cross-scene multi-view pitch homography benchmark across 15 real match scenes (median E_X=0.460m, P95=0.587m).
25-scenario diagnostic Law 11 evaluation benchmark covering clearly onside/offside, marginal, ball-line, halfway immunity.
Superseded by END-TO-END-EVAL-002. Evaluated pipeline causal attribution on 25 events, but used a shadow policy calculation rather than true snapshot propagation.

Multi-scene color separability (mean Lab dist=101.15, silhouette=0.751) and 100% referee & GK isolation. Validates clustering separability; absolute team accuracy pending annotated ground-truth rosters.
Smoke testing for Streamlit app: video loading, single-frame incident analysis, pitch-clipped shading, invalid calibration state, decision semantics.

Runtime performance, latency, track persistence, and temporal sync benchmark on 241-frame broadcast match footage (1280x720 @ 30 FPS). Effective FPS: 25.93 FPS (mean latency 34.18ms, P50 28.16ms, P95 33.79ms). Causal chain sync verified at contact moment t*.

Pipeline lag, coordinate boundary invariant, and temporal stability diagnostic on 241-frame 1080p match footage. Resolved x=1537 mystery (source is 1920x1080, 0 OOB violations). Zero contact evaluated from predicted/lost ball. Confirmed YOLO recall (81.9% of non-observed frames) and TeamClassifier latency (31.3%) as primary bottlenecks.

Full pipeline causal attribution across 25 diagnostic events with wired-up boundary_status propagation through EvidenceSnapshot. Geometric Decision Acc: 24/25 (96.0%), Policy Acc: 25/25 (100.0%), Signed Margin MAE: 0.143m. Review Split: 17 Decisive, 4 Marginal, 4 Undetermined. Zero-failure traversal: 22/25 (88.0%).

Comparative benchmark of 3 ball perception architectures (Baseline vs. ROI-Only vs. Hybrid Recovery). Variant C Hybrid achieved 70.1% raw detection (+9.5% over baseline) and 61.8% observed coverage (+9.9% over baseline, 24 fewer dropout frames), with 100% contact coverage.

Compute optimization and stability benchmark across 4 TeamClassifier variants (A Baseline, B Fast, C Cached, D Fast+Cached). Winning Variant D achieved 0.62ms mean latency (20.03x speedup vs 12.42ms baseline), crushed tail from 75.25ms to 3.43ms max, reduced KMeans calls by 71.3%, maintained 100% Law 11 decision invariance, and established canonical luminance cluster anchoring.

Dynamic homography benchmark under camera motion comparing Static H0 (A), Raw LK on pitch markings (B), and Guarded Hybrid LK with fallback (C). Static A failed under pan (37.55m drift). Raw LK B tracked pan (0.88m drift) but suffered catastrophic condition number explosion (kappa(H) grew 47x to 155,335). Guarded Hybrid C successfully intercepted 9 collinearity collapses and 31 condition explosions, maintaining projective convexity. Recommended policy: Conditional use of Variant C gated by motion classification.
